reciprocal.link: PP051 — Treat creativity as a process, not a trait
reciprocal.why: PP051 treats creativity as a process rather than a trait, grounded in the Hennessey and Amabile 2010 review (novel-and-appropriate definition, training meta-analysis, both stable aspects and environmental influence), the psychological anchor for the concept page's philosophy-of-creativity strand.

reciprocal.link: D005 — Expect reversal — extremes turn into their opposites
reciprocal.why: D005 is the compendium's principle on the reversal the concept page cites from Daodejing 40, built on the Gutenberg Legge edition with verbatim chapters 9, 40 and 58.
the Daodejing's chapter 8 water image, occupying the low place without striving, is one of the text's own expressions of non-forcing.
